name: Dumbbell Stability Ball Single-Arm Chest Press
steps: Sit on the ball with a dumbbell in one hand and walk forward until the ball supports your head and upper back.
Plant your feet wide, raise your hips and hold the dumbbell over the working shoulder with your palm facing forward.
Lower the dumbbell with control toward the side of your chest with your elbow angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the weight back up to full extension, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Brace your core hard and squeeze your glutes to stop your hips or shoulders from rolling off the ball.
Start with a lighter dumbbell until your balance on the ball feels solid.
